API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIServer ManagementAdds a new Server for the specified customer.
Adds a new Server for the specified customer.
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/server

Adds a new Server for the specified customer.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the Microtenant for the ZPA tenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. Pass microtenantId as null to retrieve data from all customers associated with the tenant.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
address
string
appServerGroupIds

configSpace
string

Possible values: [DEFAULT, SIEM]

REQUIRED

microtenantName
string
modifiedBy

int32

string
REQUIRED
